title: On the hull of linearized polynomial codes
summary: Motivated by entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes, where the hull dimension determines the number of required pre-shared entangled pairs, we study hulls of two families of $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear codes defined by $q$-polynomial operators over $\mathbb{F}_{q^m}$. Our main tool is a unified Gram-matrix method. For image codes $\mathcal{C}(\boldsymbolα)=\operatorname{im}Φ_{\boldsymbolα}$, with $Φ_{\boldsymbolα}=\sum_iα_iF_i$, we prove the master hull--rank formula…
